instruction:
One-Storey School Wing Link Conversion and Works Schedule

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited renovation works schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey and exactly 7 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 4 IfcWall entities, at least 1 IfcSlab entity, and at least 1 IfcRoof entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: CLASSROOM-1, CLASSROOM-2, CLASSROOM-3, CLASSROOM-4, CORRIDOR, CONNECTOR, and STORE.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [30.0, 10.0, 3.3].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: Status, Category, Quantity.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 5 data rows in this order: DEMOLISH PartitionWalls 18.6, DEMOLISH OldCorridorSegment 9.2, NEW ConnectorWalls 24.4, NEW ClassroomPartitions 16.8, and NEW GlazedLink 10.5, each Quantity value with tolerance +/-0.10.
11. The sum of all schedule Quantity values is between 79.4 and 79.6.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.

command: if exist "C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Archicad 29\Archicad Starter.exe" (echo OK) else (echo MISSING & exit /b 1)
